test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). G is sitting second to the right of B. Only two people are sitting between E and C when counted from the left of E. G is an immediate neighbour of E. A is sitting second to the left of C. D is not an immediate neighbour of B.

What is the position of F with respect to G?
solution:
Given:

Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table.

G is sitting second to the right of B. G is an immediate neighbour of E.

Only two people are sitting between E and C when counted from the left of E.

A is sitting second to the left of C.

D is not an immediate neighbour of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9367f6c3d8bf65b4a2bed1bdf1aceedcd160bfa69ced751f8fa92af47d753fb3.png] 

Thus, 'F' sits third to the left of 'G'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
